commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' One of the players from Valencia times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+2' Adu Ares (Ath Bilbao) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' What was Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
88' A free kick from around the half-way line will be taken by Ath Bilbao.
86' The ball possession at the moment is 40:60.
82' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Roman Yaremchuk as he is replaced by Javi Guerra (Valencia).
82' Here is a change. Diego Lopez is going off and Ruben Baraja gives the last tactical orders to Jesus Vazquez (Valencia).
82' Jose Gaya (Valencia) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Juan Pulido signals.
80' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) unleashes a decent strike heading to the bottom right corner, but the keeper dives like Superman and keeps it out.
79' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to substitute Oihan Sancet and he is replaced by Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao).
79' Nico Williams will be replaced by Adu Ares (Ath Bilbao).
77' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
75' Shots on target – 1:2.
72' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
71' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
70' Substitution. Fran Perez is replaced by Thierry Correia (Valencia).
69' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor prepares a substitution. Gorka Guruzeta is replaced by Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao).
69' Substitution. Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) has come on for Benat Prados Diaz.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ander Herrera leaves the pitch and Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
67' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
66' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) sends an accurate short pass. Nico Williams controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
61' 1 - 0 Goal! Jose Gaya picks out Hugo Duro (Valencia) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the right side of the goal with a header from close range. 1:0.
61' Fran Perez (Valencia) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.

59' Unai Simon doesn't have to worry about this one. Diego Lopez plays a pass into the feet of Hugo Duro (Valencia), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the right post.
58' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) serves up a nice cross, but Giorgi Mamardashvili punches the ball away.
56' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
55' Diego Lopez (Valencia) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Unai Simon intercepts the ball.
53' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
52' Fran Perez (Valencia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
49' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' None of the Valencia players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
45+1' Valencia take a short corner kick.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
39' Valencia have a free kick.
38' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao).
37' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) finds Ander Herrera with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.
34' 41:59 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
30' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) took the corner.

28' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Giorgi Mamardashvili pulls off a brilliant save.
27' Juan Pulido blows his whistle and signals a foul after Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) brought his opponent down.
22' Fran Perez (Valencia) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
21' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
18' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ath Bilbao.

16' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) and Oihan Sancet have been trying to find each other with some accurate passes ever since the match started. These two definitely combine the most and are the team's most creative players.
14' It's time for a substitution. Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) comes on in place of Sergi Canos.
11' Sergi Canos (Valencia) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
9' Fran Perez (Valencia) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
4' Surely that's handball by one of the Ath Bilbao players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
3' Valencia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
3' Sergi Canos (Valencia) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Valencia will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Juan Pulido.
